title: Electric radiator
description: The radiator of one room. It raises the room temperature by one degree per invocation, but only while the room's door and window are both shut and the temperature is still below the setpoint. The temperature it raises is the one the room's temperature sensor reports, so heating is a cross-Thing effect.

temperatureSensor.title: The temperature sensor of this room

doorSensor.title: The door contact sensor of this room

windowSensor.title: The window contact sensor of this room

desiredTemperature.title: Setpoint the radiator heats towards; null while no setpoint is set

setDesiredTemperature.title: Set desired temperature
setDesiredTemperature.description: Set the setpoint the radiator heats towards.

increaseTemperature.title: Increase temperature
increaseTemperature.description: Heat the room by one degree. Has no effect while the door or the window is open, or while the setpoint is unset or already reached.
increaseTemperature.vre:effects:
temperatureSensor.temperature' = !doorSensor.isOpen
  && !windowSensor.isOpen
  && desiredTemperature != null
  && desiredTemperature > temperatureSensor.temperature
  ? temperatureSensor.temperature + 1
  : temperatureSensor.temperature;
output.success = !doorSensor.isOpen
  && !windowSensor.isOpen
  && desiredTemperature != null
  && desiredTemperature > temperatureSensor.temperature;
output.temperature = temperatureSensor.temperature';
